title: the RSS channel must contain title, link, and description

spec.name: RSS 2.0
spec.normative_quote: Here's a list of the required channel elements, each with a brief description, an example, and where available, a pointer to a more complete description.... title The name of the channel.... link The URL to the HTML website corresponding to the channel.... description Phrase or sentence describing the channel.
spec.note: Separate table passages are joined with ellipses and checked in source order.

applicability: The <channel> element of a parsed RSS 2.0 document.
expectation: The channel contains non-empty title, link, and description elements.

cases.name: a channel missing link and description emits one finding per field
